title: Build it: object-aware AR
notes: Teaching extension: current implementation is local detection + approximate 3D localization. Object-bound menus are the XR-Objects-inspired next layer, not an implemented feature.

title: From labels to XR-Objects
takeaway: The goal is an interface attached to a real object — not just a box.
notes: Related work: Augmented Object Intelligence with XR-Objects, Dogan et al., UIST2024, doi10.1145/3654777.3676379, https://xr-objects.github.io/. Original evaluated phone prototype uses ARFoundation/ARCore + on-device MediaPipe object detection and cloud PaLI. Diagram is a conceptual next step for this Quest sample; object menu, selection, LLM and actions are NOT implemented.

title: Detection is not yet tracking
takeaway: Each additional capability needs a new representation.
notes: Source: QuestYolo.cs Draw() destroys and recreates annotations each inference; no temporal IDs or persistent anchors. Ladder is a teaching classification, not a measured performance claim. Center ray surface point is not full 3D object center.

title: How it runs on the headset
takeaway: Pixels provide semantics; geometry places the result in the room.
notes: Source QuestYolo.cs Start(), Decode(), Draw(). Snapshot resized640x640; YOLOv9 ONNX, class threshold.35 class-aware NMS.45, calibrated exposure-time camera pose. Environment depth used for center ray, corners projected on plane. Arrows show actual data flow; depth branch merges after inference.

title: A ray turns a pixel into a 3D point
takeaway: Use the detection center — not the center of the headset display.
notes: Conceptual geometry (not measured scale): captured camera position o and calibrated ViewportPointToRay direction d. EnvironmentRaycastManager.Raycast returns hit.point P=o+t*d. A camera-parallel plane through P supplies all four box corner intersections. Center may be background. No exact object mesh or geometric centroid is recovered.

title: Unity native versus WebXR
takeaway: Local inference is possible in both; camera and geometry access differ.
notes: README/VERIFICATION: native physically accepted; Web model inference verified on desktop CPU WASM only. Current WebXR displays preview panel, not equivalent first-person object overlay. Quest Browser camera during XR, performance and Raw Camera Access support unverified. WebGPU is not the current web backend.

title: Next: make each object actionable
takeaway: An XR-Objects-inspired extension — not yet in this demo.
notes: Proposed next layer, not implemented: class-aware temporal association and depth gated smoothing; stable object record; selection using hand/controller ray; contextual menu attached to measured object point; local actions first, optional remote reasoning separately disclosed. Original XR-Objects phone prototype uses cloud reasoning; our local YOLO claim does not imply local LLM. Semantic object point must remain distinguishable from actual mesh/anchor.
